## Hypothesis

The vwap_overnight_grinder_5keepers candidate aims to capture the overnight edge in the SPY market by using a VWAP-based trigger. The hypothesis is that the SPY price will follow the VWAP during overnight hours, and a trading strategy can be designed to take advantage of this edge.

## Mechanism

The mechanism for this candidate involves using a VWAP-based trigger to enter trades during overnight hours. The trigger will be based on the SPY price crossing above or below the VWAP. The entry will be at the next bar open after the trigger fires. The stop will be a chart stop at the opposite extreme of the entry bar, and the target will be a +50% premium gain.
